name: Do You Need to Leave Your House During Refinishing?
title-tag: Do You Need to Leave the House During Floor Refinishing?
meta-description: With waterborne finishes, most families stay home through a refinish. What each day feels like, the noise and access problems to plan for, and when to leave.
post-summary: November 11, 2026 · With modern waterborne finishes, most families stay home through the whole refinish — the real planning problems are sanding noise and blocked rooms, not air. A day-by-day look from inside the house, plus the two cases where we’ll tell you to book somewhere else.
